_comment: This repository INSTANTIATES the smart-base harness, as litlfred/smart-trust's seed does (folio-assistant bean rbz3, branch claude/seed-smart-base). Mode: the harness is put ON this repository and the site is built HERE (folio-assistant bean b5f0's second mode), by `.github/workflows/folio-site.yml` with `stage-ig-sites --only smart-immunizations --source .`. The instance's artefact index and menu still come from the folio-assistant submodule (`folio-assistant/smart-immunizations/`); moving them here, or remote-mounting this repository into folio-assistant, is the next step and is the owner's call. Written with the owner's permission, 2026-10-05.
_contentType_comment: `document`. The IG's pages and artefact index are structured prose and data; there is no Lean and no TeX.
